project_type: Next.js 16 App Router web app (PhishSafe) — authorized security-awareness phishing-simulation training platform. React 19, server actions, Supabase auth/DB.
build_system: npm + Next.js 16 (next build). Tailwind CSS v4 via @tailwindcss/postcss, but the dashboard builder/studio UI uses SEMANTIC classes in src/app/globals.css (single file), NOT Tailwind utilities. The two template builders currently use raw Tailwind utility classes and are the inconsistent outliers to be unified.
test_framework: NONE. Do NOT add a test framework. Verification is build + lint + documented manual runtime checks.
test_command: npm run lint && npm run build
verification_instructions: After each feature run `npm run lint` then `npm run build`; both must pass with no new errors. There is no automated test suite. Record any runtime-only checks (AI generation, modal behavior, iframe sandbox) in the FEAT findings as 'needs runtime verification' — the dev server is `npm run dev` on port 3000 but AI calls require DASHSCOPE_API_KEY in .env and hit a live endpoint, so treat AI round-trips as manual/optional checks.
environment_constraints: AI generation hits Alibaba Cloud Model Studio (DashScope) live; requires DASHSCOPE_API_KEY (and DASHSCOPE_BASE_URL for Token Plans). Missing key returns a friendly 'not configured' error — do not treat that as a failure. Do not run destructive git commands; commit locally, never push.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING.md/.kiro steering present (verified). README documents env vars and the AI provider. PRESERVE safety posture: keep 'credentials are NOT stored' and educational-simulation copy, keep every preview iframe sandbox="", do not weaken the ai.ts safety instructions, keep the email {{link}} hard-requirement.
key_patterns: Client builder pages are 'use client' with useState-held html, POST FormData to /api/generate-content and set html state (no auto-save). Landing create (src/app/dashboard/landing-pages/create/page.tsx) is the REFERENCE pattern: .landing-studio two-column layout, .landing-editor with .editor-tabs Code/Preview, .studio-code textarea bound to html, .studio-preview iframe srcDoc={html} sandbox="", .landing-ai generator panel with .ai-files chips + .ai-generate button, inline errors via .auth-message error. Save via server actions in sibling actions.ts (createLandingPage/createTemplate/updateTemplate). List pages render the shared ResourceLibrary with createHref/createLabel linking straight to the create page. ai.ts calls DashScope OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions with messages:[{role:system},{role:user,content:[{type:text},{type:image_url}...]}], strips markdown fences, surfaces exact API errors.
relevant_files: src/app/api/generate-content/route.ts (multipart: prompt, kind, files; add currentHtml)
src/app/dashboard/templates/[id]/page.tsx (read-only view; already has sandboxless iframe preview — leave as-is)
src/components/resource-library.tsx (shared server component; createHref/createLabel; also used by audiences)
src/components/submit-button.tsx (useFormStatus submit button used by edit form)
directory_structure: src/app/dashboard/{landing-pages,templates}/ hold the builder routes; src/app/api/generate-content/route.ts is the generation endpoint; src/lib/ai.ts is the provider-neutral AI module; src/components/ holds shared client components (resource-library, submit-button) — new shared AiHtmlEditor + CreateResourceDialog go here; src/app/globals.css is the single semantic stylesheet.
